content: Used winnow's LocatingSlice<&str> as the parser Input type so every AST node gets byte-offset spans and parse errors expose e.offset().
rationale: lib.rs defines `pub(crate) type Input<'s> = LocatingSlice<&'s str>` and maps winnow errors to Error { message, offset: e.offset() }; statement and heading parsers use .with_span() to capture Span { start, end }.

content: A leading bracket is treated as a statement title only when followed by ']:'; a bare [..] without ]: is plain text, with statement references deferred to increment A2.
